name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: Skill certification initiative of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship to enable Indian youth to undergo industry-aligned vocational training.
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth seeking marketable vocational skills
School and college dropouts aged between 15 and 45 years
benefits: Free of cost short-term skill training (STT) and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), with government-funded assessment fees, government certification, and placement assistance.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE).
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

source_evidence.statement: Central skill development program executed across training centers nationwide.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

source_evidence.statement: Indian nationals aged 15-45 with basic education seeking marketable job skill certification.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

source_evidence.statement: Complete waiver of training and assessment fees with national certification upon course completion.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

source_evidence.statement: Official scheme portal on msde.gov.in and candidate registration on Skill India Digital Hub.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

source_evidence.statement: PMKVY 4.0 lifecycle operations are undergoing restructuring under Skill India Digital Hub; active batch allocation guidelines are pending publication.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Provisional criteria; general trainee age criteria captured; specific course entry prerequisites and SIDH RPL criteria pending 2026 guidelines.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI Aadhaar card for trainee identity and attendance tracking via AEBAS.
required_documents.guidance: Aadhaar is mandatory for enrollment in Skill India Digital Hub courses.

required_documents.title: Educational Qualification Certificate or Marksheet
required_documents.description: Proof of highest education attained (10th/12th or school leaving certificate).
alternatives: Self-declaration of basic literacy for RPL
required_documents.guidance: Required for specialized technical short-term courses with minimum entry qualifications.
